sources.title: Indiana nonprofit membership termination — IC 23-17-8-2 (2025 mirror)
sources.edition: 2025 code mirror; current official edition not verified
sources.scope_note: Applies to members of qualifying public/mutual benefit corporations. Do not assume an individual Scout qualifies or that a particular unit is such a corporation. Subsection (b) has alternative procedures; do not assert a universal 15-day notice requirement.

sources.title: Boy Scouts of America v. Dale, 530 US 640 (2000)
sources.scope_note: Historical adult-leader expressive-association dispute under New Jersey law. It does not supply current Scouting policy or resolve every youth membership dispute in Indiana.
